policy: Notes are keyed by the recipe that creates the item. Each entry is 'extracted' (stated directly by a pack file) or 'derived' (inferred from how several commands interact).

items.summary: A placeable defensive turret. It becomes a Lodestone that damages and slows undead and pillagers nearby while healing villagers, pets, golems, and players.

entries.text: The recipe unlocks the first time you hold a Nazar (Glistering Melon Slice). Crafting it grants the Holy Turret goal advancement in the Nether branch.

The crafted item is a spawn egg that places an invisible, invulnerable marker. On placement the marker sets a Lodestone at its position, plays a quiet Wither spawn sound, and emits soul-fire and sculk-soul particles.
Damages the nearest target within 14 blocks for 7 damage (3.5 hearts). The damage type bypasses armor.
Damage repeats on a cycle of about half a second, controlled by a 0.5 second stopwatch check. The exact firing rate is not confirmed.
Applies Slowness III to every target within 26 blocks, refreshed continuously while the stone stands.
Gives Regeneration I to villagers, wandering traders, iron and snow golems, wolves, cats, and players within 16 blocks whenever none of them already has Regeneration.
When a Wither is nearby, damage to the nearest target drops from 7 to 2.
Wither, Phantom, Pillager, Zombie, Zombie Villager, Zombified Piglin, Zoglin, Drowned, Husk, Zombie Nautilus, Skeleton, Stray, Wither Skeleton, Bogged, and Parched.
Creepers, spiders, endermen, and other mobs not on this list are unaffected. Pillagers are included even though they are not undead.
Breaking the Lodestone destroys the Warding Stone. The Lodestone drop is removed and 1 Blaze Powder drops instead, so the stone is not recovered.
A Warding Stone inside a Trial Chamber is removed and detonates as instant TNT when a player enters the chamber.
